hypothesis: This is the test arm of a seed-24 width-shrink test on data_seed 1. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-3 controls, seed 24, N=128, 6000 steps. Prediction: d_model=64 N=128 layer-1 trained force R2 is below this seed's d_model=128 N=128 value of 0.76291 (layer 1, run-20261016-072048-0756), and the layer-1 gap to the paired d_model=64 N=64 arm is >= 0.089. That would be a width-driven shrink of at least 20% relative to the d_model=128 gap of about 0.071. All scored values come from probes_final at a fixed layer 1, unrounded. Layer-4 values are reported as secondary. Within-run values are read only as same-layer control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Both arms' run IDs are cited. If the paired arm is unavailable, the gap is reported as not computed. accel_step is described only and not scored.
expected_if_true: Layer-1 N=128 force R2 <= 0.75, and layer-1 gap (paired N=64 minus this run) >= 0.089.
expected_if_false: Layer-1 gap <= 0.080, i.e. the d_model=64 deficit is no larger than the d_model=128 deficit by more than about 0.01. A gap in (0.080, 0.089) is inconclusive.
